criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: The asset identity agrees with the official WL Community School Corporation listing and address. I freshly opened the asset and independently compared its 45 unique low shell vertices against OSM way 772742586, after applying the project's documented local geographic transform. Maximum nearest-vertex discrepancy was 0.0000607 m; independently calculated shell area was 10,899.5491 m² versus source polygon 10,899.5474 m².
criteria.limitations: The mapped footprint is OpenStreetMap community data, not survey-certified wall line geometry.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The GIS-derived building shell remains in campus coordinates and matches source ring position, orientation, and plan shape at the stated numerical tolerance. The asset's whole-mesh bounds include entry/approach details outside the shell and are not used as the wall footprint.
criteria.limitations: The placement is only as authoritative as the OSM ring and the project's local approximate coordinate transform.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The overhead Esri image supports the broad crossed-wing roof plan and southeast gym/multipurpose cluster. The model contains a central clerestory node, low roof plates, monitors, and a taller gym volume. The official project/architect sources support a one-story school organization and gym/media areas only at a broad program level.
criteria.limitations: No measured elevations, dimensioned plans, or roof schedule were found. The 12.2 m maximum height, parapet heights, roof levels and exact vertical profiles remain estimates.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The architect photograph supports red-brown brick, large glazing, light metal panels, and a prominent exposed-red-steel entry. The asset includes brick piers, a red steel portal/canopy, glazed vestibule, clerestory glazing, and a gym with red trusses and bleachers. I visually inspected the saved exterior, entry, classroom, and gym renders.
criteria.limitations: Facade bay rhythm and entry canopy proportions are schematic; the rendered entry reads as a simplified flat/sloped portal compared with the photographed canopy. Exact facade orientation is not established by a cardinally oriented elevation. Classroom contents and positions are interpretive.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: A separate Blender 5.2.3 process reopened the exact hashed asset with the expected scene and collection. The collection is scene-linked, includes 1,862 objects (1,838 meshes), uses native procedural materials, and has no external file-backed image dependencies. Building-specific source register, raw GIS snapshot, evidence record, validation data, and views are present.

findings: The independent fresh-open and source-ring comparison confirm the GIS shell and modular asset are intact at the frozen SHA.

The three-wing/central-node arrangement and southeast program massing are plausible against the aerial and architect narrative; interior room positions and the roof's vertical detailing are not source-verifiable.
The model includes a clearly supported entry language and gym character, though its facade and canopy remain conceptual rather than measured.
No model edits were made during grading.
